answer_1.quote: Our work proposed NitiBench which fills this gap with two Thai legal-QA datasets plus sectionlevel retrieval and E2E evaluation metrics...
answer_1.outputs: Free-form text answers to legal questions

answer_2.quote: We propose multi-label retrieval metrics and E2E metrics that assess accuracy, consistency, and legal citation quality... Recall@k, MRR@k, Multi-HitRate@k, Multi-MRR@k, Coverage, Citation precision/recall/F1, Contradiction

answer_3.quote: Both citation and contradiction scores are computed using LLM-as-a-judge, where we use gpt-4o-2024-08-06 as a judge model with a temperature of 0.3.

answer_4.quote: The generated answer y and positive sections T are further validated by legal experts for assuring data quality... We also tune our prompt to ensure that the judge LLM achieves a high agreement with humans.
answer_4.guideline: Legal experts validate answers/sections; measure LLM-human agreement for coverage/contradiction scores
